INSERT INTO physical_doc_permission (doc_id, doc_name, dept, dept_name, project_code, project_name, operate_type, scope, zone_codes, status, granted_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.docId}, #{item.docName}, #{item.dept}, #{item.deptName}, #{item.projectCode}, #{item.projectName}, #{item.operateType}, #{item.scope}, #{item.zoneCodes}, #{item.status}, #{item.grantedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE doc_name = VALUES(doc_name), dept = VALUES(dept), dept_name = VALUES(dept_name), project_name = VALUES(project_name), operate_type = VALUES(operate_type), scope = VALUES(scope), zone_codes = VALUES(zone_codes), status = VALUES(status), update_time = NOW()
